about.what: acquisition policies under the official protocol (budget-major, one shared labeled, fresh instances per checkpoint) against the platform's random rule, with random against random (placebo) as the noise floor; hier-ship over leave-one-parent-out priors on test-like runs, paired
about.plan: docs/plans/p2_final_plan.md R5; the v2 outline's T4 row 7 and App F.8
about.sign: D = ALC(policy) - ALC(reference); negative means the policy is better

references.placebo: the rule on a salted key
references.two_arm_mean: (random + placebo) / 2, per run and per pair

about.se: run_se = sd over runs / sqrt(R) (the scratch's); cluster_se = bootstrap over (parent, subject) clusters, 2,000 resamples, seed 0
about.tl_bar: the harness gate's test-like bar, TL delta <= -0.002 (report section 4.4), for reference; the gate also needs public runs and per-parent checks, not run here
about.id_use: replica pairs only; no formative feedback is read; pairs are written as (parent, cluster index)

checks.check: every row was scored with the current library and policies
every main run is stored (both batches, runs 0-89)
no hier failure (fallback prediction) in any scored run
random is the platform's rule and every policy a streaming hook
every scratch summary value reproduces to its recorded precision or is explained
fixed batch: every scratch row reproduces bit for bit (ALC and Brier by budget)
salted batch: every scratch row reproduces bit for bit (ALC and Brier by budget)

explained.fixed_scratch_subset/uncertain/minus_two: protocol.md section 5.9a derived '-0.0008' from the summary's 5-dp values (uncertain - random +0.00029, placebo - random +0.00228: 0.00029 - 0.00228 / 2 = -0.00085) and wrote it to 4 dp; at full precision it is -0.000856, -0.0009 at 4 dp. The outline's T4 note ('policies -0.0008 to -0.0019 against the mean of two random arms') therefore reads -0.0009 to -0.0019 on the scratch's own sets (scratch_ranges).
